group_scores.rationale: HY OAS +53bp (every session wider, +24bp on 11/20) and CCC +86bp to about 14%, alongside an 8.6% S&P 500 drop: risk-off stress down the quality curve. IG OAS rose only 9bp and IG all-in yields fell. LQD rose about 0.9% in the window, so the pack's -4.08% is contradicted. All credit evidence is ICE/FRED price data from one source family. With no non-price source (defaults, BDC gates, issuance), the score stays at 0 with a negative lean.

That is a price-led AI/tech de-leveraging, not a confirmed policy or fundamental shift. The Nvidia beat and lower yields offset the hawkish Fed. Price action alone does not carry a score, so 0.
group_scores.falsifier: A confirmed 50bp December signal or earnings-guidance cuts (-1). A sustained yield decline with a stabilizing tape (+1).

The verifier confirmed this on both the NVIDIA release (T1) and CNBC (T2), both dated 11/17. That is a concrete fundamental beat. It is capped at +1 (also the unsaturated cap) by the CEO resignation and investigation, the hawkish Fed, the gross-margin dip to 71-72%, the China exclusion, and a weak tape: NDX fell 2.2% on 11/19 and the S&P 500 lost 8.6% on the week.
